create_MinitaurBulletEnv: create a MinitaurBulletEnv gym environment instance with configurable reward weights and motor control settings
run_step_simulation: run a simulation step on the minitaur environment by passing desired motor angle actions
reset_MinitaurBulletEnv: reset the minitaur simulation environment to initial state with optional hard or soft reset
render_MinitaurBulletEnv: render the minitaur simulation as an RGB array image from a camera view
review_is_fallen: review the is_fallen method to check if the minitaur base orientation or height indicates a fall
